coverage_note: Whole file read. Holes: many Medi lines 18:14-36:36 are '[speaking Arabic]' (untranscribed) so his exact forms there are unseen (rows written from her fix only, marked low/medium); 40:47-59:51 Medi is in ad-hoc Latin (bakharreb, kharabtihum...), kept as printed. His answer to her 31:32 command question (31:32-31:57) is not transcribed at all. Left out as S4 pronunciation: قربان for خربان 10:55, banbesit/babsit 58:22, bazaui/banzaouj 58:50, ملايين→مليان self-fix 01:05, بغلط→بالغلط self-fix 39:42, الغرف 39:35 (dropped ة). Left out as asked-form questions with no error: 05:57 بيكون/أكون, 17:31 تباي/تبعيت (AC possession, her reply garbled), 35:56/36:19/40:47/40:58 'is it X or Y' form checks, 25:49 يخربوا?, 51:40 'wawu ha' (her lights) never answered. 'Mashrofa' at 1:02:27 unclear. Her 03:58 'قد' and 42:27 'مش أزتم' are garbled transcriptions. medi_turns is approximate: 184 Arabic-script Medi lines + 34 '[speaking Arabic]' lines + ~45 Latin-arabizi lines.

rows.medi_said: Review. What was the word for review?
rows.amal_said: As a noun it's مراجعة. So what's-- what is it as a verb?
rows.why: He asked for the word; she supplied it (didn't-know, tier 0). Sheet: 'review | Muraaja3a | مراجعة' and 'i review | Ana baraaje3 | أنا براجع'.
She asked for the verb form; he repeated the noun مراجعة and she supplied the verb براجع (wrong form of a word he knows).

rows.medi_said: أنا راح أعمل الـ، واجب الـ، آآآ، امبارح والواجب اليوم آآآم، الليلة.
rows.why: Idafa 'yesterday's homework' with el- on the first noun (heavy stutter; may be a restart rather than an error); she let it pass.
rows.english: I will do yesterday's homework and today's tonight

rows.medi_said: اليوم، مم؟ اليوم يوم الـ، جمع
rows.why: Friday is يوم الجمعة; he said 'يوم الـ جمع' (could be a dropped ة = pronunciation); her 03:58 line 'قد' is garbled so no visible fix.

rows.right: إحداش الشهر التاسع / أيلول ألفين وستة وعشرين (best reading)
rows.why: Date read as bare digits 'eleven nine 2026' with no month word; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: آآآ، الشمال الـ، روسيا the, the north of Russia. الشمال.
rows.why: Idafa: first noun never takes el-; he said الشمال الروسيا, she recast شمال روسيا (again at 05:37 'بس شمال روسيا').

rows.amal_said: أمم، you can use be going.
rows.why: Repeat of the el- on the idafa head right after her 05:06 fix; she let it pass this time.
Second ykoon in the chain dropped its b- with no modal before it (B1); also masc. بيمطر where her sheet has 'it's raining | Betma66er | بتمطر' (B18); she let it pass.
مغني (singer) is a non-word here for مغيمة (cloudy); he half self-fixed with 'نوع مغيمة' and she recast the phrase with مغيمة. Sheet: 'it's cloudy | M8ayyme | مغيمة'.

rows.medi_said: How do I say dark again؟
rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked, she supplied عتمة. Sheet: 'darkness | 3etme | عتمة'.

rows.amal_said: آه، يعني yes، عادةً إنت بتحب تنام بالعتمة أو بالضوء؟
rows.why: Feminine command 'ask me' came out as ساليني (missing the command shape; may be S4 dropped hamza); she just re-asked her question.

rows.medi_said: أنا بشتغل أحسن في الليل في الـ.
rows.why: Time-of-day takes بـ in Levantine (بالليل); he used في; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: Is it Asafa؟ Is that, is that stars؟
rows.why: He offered عاصفة for 'stars'; she said no, it means storm, and gave نجمة/نجوم. Sheet: 'it's stormy | El-denia 3awaasef | الدنيا عواصف'.

rows.medi_said: is it أنجم؟ I don't know. أنجم، نجوم،
rows.why: She prompted 'what's multiple?'; he first repeated the singular نجمة (09:19), then guessed the invented plural أنجم before نجوم; she confirmed نجوم.

rows.medi_said: الـ المدينة حوالين or الـ المدينة سان فرانسيسكو Oakland
rows.amal_said: What's the، what's-- وشو جمع غريب؟
rows.why: English 'or' dropped between two Arabic phrasings; sheet: 'or | Aw | أو'. Low because he may have been choosing between phrasings (meta).
rows.english: the cities around, or the cities San Francisco, Oakland

rows.amal_said: What's the، what's-- وشو جمع غريب؟ ... غراب.
rows.why: Plural subject (the cities) needs the plural adjective قراب; he gave singular قريب then MSA قريبًا (her sheet: 'soon | qareeban | قريباً'); she prompted the plural and he landed on قراب مني (10:37).

تحت = under/bottom used for 'the end of the word'; she prompted 'The end' and he fixed to آخر الكلمة, which she confirmed. Sheet: 'down / under / bottom / below | Ta7t | تحت', 'last / the end of | 2aa5er | آخر'.
She had modelled بنزيد (we add) at 11:28; he produced مزيد (wrong form / not a verb); she said مم and moved on.
Either she rejects the el- on the idafa head (الأول الكلمة → أول الكلمة, A2) or her 'لا، أول' is لأول = 'to the beginning' replacing his ع (D1); the transcript cannot separate the two.
rows.english: to the beginning of the word

rows.medi_said: آآآ، بر-- بخرب. بخرب ... means to make something stop working.
rows.amal_said: مم. It's not بخرب yet. It's بخرب. ... Yeah. (13:23 Medi: I stop working)
rows.right: بخرَب = I stop working / get ruined (not 'I make it stop')
rows.why: Make-X vs get-X: he read the derived verb as causative; she said it is not (yet) بخرِّب, it is بخرَب, and he restated 'I stop working'.
Past 'she' ending: he said خربات, she recast خربت; he repeated خربات at 16:18 and she recast again (16:21 'خربت. خربوا.').
Retelling her 'my AC stopped working yesterday'; بارد (cold) appears where 'yesterday' (مبارح) fits; may be a transcription slip; she let it pass.
صحح (to correct) used for 'fix'; she recast صلحته and he repeated it.

rows.amal_said: بس still هذا الفعل الثاني. ... أمم، not بخرب. بخرب that would be.
rows.wrong: [speaking Arabic] (form II بخرِّب used for 'it stops working')
rows.why: She says he used 'the second verb' (the doubled make-form) when he meant 'it stops working'; his Arabic line is not transcribed.
She recast بتستعمل twice (20:58, 21:13) and at 21:19 he says 'oh, that's right, it's she and not you' - he had conjugated for 'you' (f.) instead of 'she'; his line untranscribed.

rows.medi_said: Uh, but [speaking Arabic] oh, that's right, it's she and not you. [speaking Arabic]
rows.why: Object fronted (كل إشي ...) so the verb needs the pointer -ه; she recast بتستعمله and then 21:53 'كل إشي بتستعمله بيخرب'.

rows.amal_said: بس. بيخرب. بس بيخرب. ... No, because it breaks ... So كل إشي بتستعمله بيخرب.
rows.why: He asked at 21:32 whether the second verb also needs the pointer and then said it with one / plural; she said no, كل إشي is one thing, just بيخرب.
After إذا ما the present verb keeps its b-; he said ما تفتحي (command shape), she said 'With B' and modelled ما بتحطي.
'If you don't OPEN the fridge' where the meaning is 'put it in the fridge'; she recast with حط. Sheet: 'put | 7ott | حط', 'open | Efta7 | افتح'. He repeated بتفتحي at 26:12 and she let it go.
rows.english: if you don't put it (in the fridge)

rows.why: Object pronoun for the rice missing on the verb (بتحطيه) and 'هي' stands where في / بـ the fridge is expected; she said ممتاز.
rows.english: if you don't put it in the fridge

rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked what تذاكر means in her example; she answered.

rows.amal_said: عزومة is feminine or masculine؟ ... خربت.
rows.why: Subject العزومة is feminine; he said خرب, she prompted the gender and gave خربت.

rows.amal_said: ما؟ ما it didn't come. ما أجا.
rows.why: She queried his 'ما ...' and recast ما أجا; his line is untranscribed so the exact slip is unseen.

rows.amal_said: Mm-mm. تنورة is skirt. ... فستانك. صح.
rows.why: تنورة (skirt) for 'dress'; she said no, that is skirt, he then said فستانك and she confirmed. Sheet: 'dress | Fus6aan | فستان', 'skirt | Tannoora | تنورة'.

rows.amal_said: Mm-hmm. يلا أعطيني إنت دورك هلأ.
rows.why: Feminine noun + possessive ending needs the -t (غرفتك); transcript shows غرفةك (no t); she let it pass. Sheet shows the pattern: 'a bedroom | 8urfet noam'.
Feminine جلاية + -ك needs the -t: she prompted 'جلاية؟', he fixed to جلايتك, she confirmed. (Sheet lists 'dish washer | Jallaay | جلاي'; in the lesson she treats it as جلاية.)

rows.amal_said: مش، مش أزتم or it's past also. ... ممتاز (42:48)
rows.why: 'They didn't mean to' is past, needs كان; she prompted 'it's past also', he reached ما كان قصدهم at 42:45.

rows.medi_said: Uh, مش كان and, uh, مش...
rows.amal_said: Not مش. [تضحك] If you use can. Not can.
rows.why: Negating the verb كان takes ما, not مش; she said 'Not مش' and he fixed to ما كان.

rows.amal_said: So، في عندنا خلاص ما can is a verb. Because can and then the verb after it should be what؟ ... صح.
rows.why: After ما كان قصدهم the next verb is bare present (يخربوا), not past خربوا; she prompted and he produced yecharbu (43:10).

rows.amal_said: So it's بخرررب. There is a double medal here. ... No. خرب. ... When do I not put the a in command؟
rows.why: Command of a doubled-middle verb takes no e- prefix; he said echarrab, she said no, خرب, and named the rule (no 'a' when the middle is doubled).

rows.amal_said: Mm-mm, no. [speaks Arabic] ... So they are what's breaking. Did you break them؟
rows.why: She said no to his 'بضلوا يخربوا' but her Arabic fix is not transcribed; from 53:26 she seems to hear the make-form (they break something) rather than 'they break down'.
rows.english: why do your keys keep breaking

rows.why: 'Did you break them' is past; he gave present بتخربي, she prompted 'Did you?', he said 'oh, past tense' and produced خربتيهم.

rows.amal_said: Which, which one is it؟ [speaks Arabic] (55:07 Medi: I knew that.)
rows.right: صورنا خربت (best reading; her line untranscribed)
rows.why: Subject صورنا (non-human plural) - he tried kharab then kharabu; she asked which and gave the form (untranscribed); his 'I knew that' shows it differed from his.

rows.amal_said: ليش؟ You would ruin it؟ ... one T ... اه، راح تخربيها.
rows.why: The soup as object must ride on the verb (-ها); she prompted 'you would ruin IT?' and he added -ha, then she modelled راح تخربيها.
After راح the form is تخربي (one t-prefix); he doubled it (titkharabi); she said 'No two T. Why two Ts?' and 'one T'.

rows.amal_said: Yes, بس we're talking about شوربة. So... صح (57:42)
rows.why: شوربة is feminine so the verb is تخرب; he said يخرب, she prompted the subject and he fixed to tikhreb.
He could not recall yesterday's pair; she gave the English hint 'break' and he produced bakser / bankeser. Sheet: 'i break | Ana bakser | أنا بكسر'.
